feature_contract.goal: Make the complete F11 shell, notification and bindings input separation robust across hidden gameplay, visible VR shell, focus loss and source/eye viewport resize without breaking headset font density or desktop operation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: External ImGui overlay Win32 input and VR shell bounds only; not game sprite HUD, ESC menus, SkyGlow, camera, stereo, FFB or backend selection.
trace_stages: Game Win32 WndProc enters ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler even when F11 is closed, competing with original game mouse/cursor input.
The same Win32 backend owns F11 legacy keyup, binding-dialog focus and independently interactive notification HUD events.
F11 render_shell uses source DisplaySize and XR density to center initial geometry; missing live manual resize constraints allow later shell clipping.
subcomponents: Isolate hidden gameplay pointer/cursor path while preserving legacy F11 key down/up and focus cleanup.
Retain binding-dialog and notification HUD mouse routing, and constrain the full VR shell including tabs/input controls across mirror Reset/resize.
Add exact producer-bound input and geometry negative/mutation regressions and require full Win32 game/host/package + isolation GitHub gate.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Hidden gameplay mouse and cursor routes to game; open F11, bindings, legacy toggle and interactive notifications retain ImGui input.
Manual F11 VR resizing respects real content rectangle over desktop/eye resizing while desktop saved geometry and F11 font density remain untouched.
Run F11 positive negative and mutation tests and complete exact-SHA Win32 host game package and Domain Isolation, with Quest3 runtime approval separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The Win32 hook forwards mouse-wheel and cursor events to ImGui even with overlayActive=false, while render_shell limits only the first appearing geometry and has no user-resize size constraints.
source_trace: WndProc destination forwards every event unconditionally to ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler prior to original game WndProc.
ImGui backend consumes input for external F11 shell, modal binding dialog and HUD notices; hidden gameplay shares same original input hook.
Overlay::render_shell source rectangle and VR density set initial centered size but do not clamp subsequent manual resizing.
diagnosis.root_cause: ImGui event ownership was not scoped to visible shell/binding/interactive notifications; VR shell maximum bounds are not persistent after initial appearance.
alternatives_rejected: Reset-only initial placement cannot bound a later user-initiated resize.
Disabling all ImGui messages when F11 is closed breaks legacy F11 keyup, focus cleanup and interactive HUD notifications.
Global game HUD projection and XR eye RT changes do not address Win32 input or F11 window geometry.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This change does not change external ScreenOverlay2D stereo projection or atlas; it limits ImGui input ownership and VR ImGui window bounds before rendering.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Original F11 WndProc source now gates ImGui on shell, binding dialog, legacy key release, focus cleanup and interactive notification ownership; portable C++17 static_assert and separate VR size constraints modify real runtime source at material SHA 36228021f07df816d7dff6ea2e29215ceb6637e5.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: New tools/verify_vr_f11_wndproc_shell.py models closed/open/binding/F11 key/focus/notification cases and destructive routing mutations, small/portrait/ultrawide VR shell geometry; existing F11 font density, toggle, HUD policy, host and reset regressions passed exact SHA DX9Ex Active #38496946175 5/5.

runtime_gate: QUEST3_VDXR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION_REQUIRED: HMD game screenshot, F11 visible/hidden keyboard-mouse interaction, notification clicks, focus Alt-Tab, 3440x1440 and resized/reset source window. Actual HMD test not performed; RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED. DXVK frozen.
